summary: MaintTemplates provides a web-based maintenance interface for managing template records in HSPnet. Users can add, edit, delete, and filter templates. The interface uses ASP.NET controls to facilitate CRUD operations, validation, error/warning messaging, and supports multi-locale templates.
purpose: To allow authorized users to maintain a list of templates with names and content, including alternate locale descriptions, in a structured, validated, and user-friendly manner.

entities.name: TemplateRecord
entities.description: Represents a template entry with Name, Template, TemplateAlt fields, and ID.

entities.name: Templates
entities.description: Collection/class for retrieving and manipulating template data.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for each template record.

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Template name. Required field with max length 50.

workflows.name: Template Maintenance
steps: Page loads; sets up session context.
User optionally enters Keyword for filtering.
User clicks Refresh to filter template list.
Grid displays templates with Name, Template, TemplateAlt.
User clicks Add to create a new template (shows DetailsView).
User enters Name, Template, TemplateAlt; validation required.
User clicks Save: If valid and ID=0, adds new; else updates existing.
User clicks Edit on a row to modify existing template (DetailsView opens; values populated).
User clicks Delete to permanently remove template (confirmation handled).
System shows error/warning messages as needed; panels can be hidden.
After add/edit/delete, grid is refreshed and main panel updated.

business_rules: Name, Template, and TemplateAlt fields must be specified (required).
Name field max length is 50 characters.
Keyword filtering applies wildcard if empty.
validations: DisplayMode for ValidationSummary is List; ShowMessageBox enabled.
Errors and warnings are shown in dedicated panels.

calculations.name: TruncateString
calculations.description: Template and TemplateAlt fields are truncated to 75 characters in grid display.

conditions: If Page.IsValid on save, then update/add record.
If ID=0, add new record; else update existing.
system_behavior: Panel for error/warning messages shown/hidden based on actions.
GridData row command handler dispatches actions for Add, Edit, Delete.
DetailsView handles Save, Cancel for template editing.
RefreshData fetches templates filtered by keyword.
Page setup and teardown handled on load/unload.
Ajax UpdatePanel used for responsive UI updates.
exceptions: Invalid input triggers error panel with list of issues.
Delete actions require user confirmation (no undo).
content_gaps: Underlying database schema and stored procedures not shown.
